summary: No security findings. Anti-SSRF preserved (media URLs/file_ids are serialized into the request body for Telegram to fetch; the backend never dereferences them — Decision 6). Token-scrub parity is intact in the album mapper: result.description() is run through TelegramApiClient.scrubTokens before every log.warn and before the thrown exception message, matching mapBodyToSentMessage exactly (proven by sendMediaGroup_okFalseWithToken_scrubbedInLog). No new token handling — album path reuses the existing sendOnce per-attempt AES-GCM decrypt seam. No hardcoded secrets, no injection (Jackson-serialized body).

owasp_checks.A03_injection_xss: no string concat into URL/query; body is Jackson-serialized
owasp_checks.A09_logging: token scrub applied at all new log + exception sites (parity verified)
owasp_checks.A10_ssrf: no media dereference; URL/file_id passed opaquely to Telegram
